name: thrixel
description: Build playable 3D browser games with AI-generated assets, right in ChatGPT. The build-world skill takes an idea to a finished three.js game: Thrixel generates, refines and textures the game-ready .glb models, and the game is published to a public thrixel.world link anyone can play.

interface.longDescription: Build World turns a one-line game idea into a 3D game you can play in the browser. It settles what you are making, generates the 3D models with Thrixel (game-ready .glb files you own), writes the three.js game around them (scene, controls, UI and touch input), and publishes it to a public thrixel.world link you can share. Everything runs on Thrixel's servers, so there is nothing to install: connect your Thrixel account once and ask for a game.
defaultPrompt: Build a submarine exploration game in three.js set in a bright tropical sea with coral and fish.
Build a fantasy RPG in three.js set in a misty mountain village with villagers to talk to.
Build an explorable 3D solar system in three.js I can fly through, with labelled planets.
